Subject: Multiparametric MRI of the Prostate
Facility: Ziekenhuis Gelderse Vallei (Ede) | 02 Dec 2024
Indication: Rising PSA (4.1 ng/mL) alongside prior biopsy bucket "Positive".

Findings: The gland measures 31.0 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a 12 mm focal hypointensity within the left mid-gland peripheral zone. Marked diffusion restriction accompanies this area, paired with low ADC signal. Early focal enhancement appears on DCE relative to adjacent tissue. Extracapsular extension and seminal vesicle invasion are absent. Pelvic lymph nodes show no suspicious features.

Impression: PI-RADS 4 lesion located in the left mid-gland peripheral zone. Prostate volume 31.0 mL. PSAD 0.13 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.8615541
